## Course packets — Paper 2 first, then Paper 1

Order of teaching: **all of Paper 2, then all of Paper 1.** Tick a row in this file when the packet has
been taught — change `☐` to `☑` in `students/yejun/index.qmd`.

◆ marks the six packets his wrong answers on 2016 Paper 2 pointed at.

**Pacing.** Only about **eight of the eleven months are usable**: Nov–Mar is the clean block, Apr–May goes
to AP exams, Jun–Aug is the summer push, and Sep–Oct collides with G12 starting and UCAS. Aim to finish
**all of Paper 2 by March 2027**, use the summer for Paper 1 and timed mocks, and keep the last six weeks
for revision only.
